steps.en: Check out the last Apache-2.0 commit; later code is Enterprise-licensed
steps.zh: 检出最后一个 Apache-2.0 提交，之后的代码是企业许可

steps.en: Install the toolchain and start the whole stack with the repo's dev tool
steps.zh: 用仓库自带的开发工具装好工具链，拉起整套服务

steps.en: Connect your code hosts with a token that can read every repo
steps.zh: 接入代码托管平台，给一个能读所有仓库的 token

steps.en: Lists the repos and keeps a full clone of each in sync, within code-host rate limits
steps.zh: 列出所有仓库，在限流范围内为每个仓库保持一份完整克隆

steps.en: Builds a trigram index of every default branch
steps.zh: 给每个默认分支建三字母组索引

steps.en: Type one query in the web UI across all repositories
steps.zh: 在网页界面里输入一条查询，覆盖所有仓库

steps.en: Answers from the index, scans unindexed branches directly, and links matches to definitions and references
steps.zh: 从索引里回答，未索引的分支直接扫，并把结果连到定义和引用

value.en: One search box over every repository and branch — and, for this snapshot, a readable blueprint of how that product was built
value.zh: 一个搜索框搜遍所有仓库和分支；对这份快照来说，它更是一份能读懂的产品架构蓝图

sources: https://github.com/sourcegraph/sourcegraph-public-snapshot#readme (notice: commit 1cd36d2dbbd2a9ab638cc437d208d2717eaefb0b is the last one under an Apache License)

https://github.com/sourcegraph/sourcegraph-public-snapshot/blob/main/doc/dev/background-information/architecture/index.md (repo-updater, gitserver, zoekt trigram index of default branches, searcher for unindexed search, search-based and precise code navigation)
